text_en: The dragon ahead... It will soon be reborn, and I will be the one to end it once more...
That power drew you here too, admit it...
Now do you understand why we have no other choose than to hoard power?
Otherwise, how would you have gotten this far?
Killing... Through it, we came into this world and carved out our path.
There's something here that seems to reward those like us. You've have noticed it too... haven't you?
The power that's been with you ever since you set foot here belongs to all of us. I couldn't wish for a greater destiny than becoming part of it.
See you soon... Soldier of Zarga.
